Vault Initialization

Vault Initialization establishes the global execution environment required for all FeatureCells. It configures platform-wide behavior such as scheduling, diagnostics, and logging policy before any pipeline execution occurs.

Initialization Contract Summary

  • Vault initialization must occur once at application startup
  • Initialization is global and affects all FeatureCells
  • Configuration applies platform-wide and is not FeatureCell-specific
  • Initialization does not modify pipeline logic or state semantics
  • All options are optional and have defined defaults

Vault initialization defines execution context only. It does not participate in state computation, pipeline stages, or value transformation. Its responsibility is limited to preparing shared runtime services required for FeatureCell execution.

Note

Vault initialization must precede FeatureCell registration. The Vault runtime is required before any FeatureCell may be declared or initialized. Calling FeatureCell prior to invoking Vault is invalid and will result in a runtime error. This ordering guarantee ensures that all FeatureCells execute within a fully prepared and consistent global execution environment.

Initialization

The Vault is initialized using the Vault API. This function establishes the global Vault runtime and must be invoked before any FeatureCells are created or initialized.

Initialization is performed once, typically during application bootstrap. Repeated calls do not create additional Vault instances and do not reconfigure existing runtime state.

Global Scope

Vault initialization is application-scoped. All FeatureCells created within the application share the same Vault runtime configuration, including queue policy, diagnostics settings, and logging behavior.

Configuration

Vault initialization accepts an optional configuration object that defines platform-level behavior. These settings influence diagnostics, scheduling infrastructure, and logging policy, but they do not alter pipeline semantics or state contracts.

All configuration options are optional. When omitted, the Vault applies its default runtime configuration.

API
Vault
Signature Description
Vault

inputs:

  • options: VaultConfig (optional)

returns: void

 Initializes the global Vault runtime using the supplied configuration. This function prepares shared execution services required by all FeatureCells and must be invoked before FeatureCell initialization.
Examples

How Vault is initialized using React.

Example 1: Initialize the Vault with Default Settings

{{`// Initialize the Vault with default configuration
Vault();`}}

Example 2: Initialize the Vault with Diagnostics Enabled 

{{`Vault({
  devMode: true,
  logLevel: 'debug'
});`}}

How Vault is initialized using Vue.

Example 1: Initialize the Vault with Default Settings

{{`// main.ts
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import { Vault } from '@sdux-vault/core';
import App from './App.vue';

// Initialize the Vault with default configuration
Vault();

createApp(App).mount('#app');`}}

Example 2: Initialize the Vault with Diagnostics Enabled 

{{`// main.ts
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import { Vault } from '@sdux-vault/core';
import App from './App.vue';

Vault({
  devMode: true,
  logLevel: 'debug'
});

createApp(App).mount('#app');`}}
